mainEntity.name: What kind of insulation is best for a garage conversion in Boise Heights?

acceptedAnswer.text: For a garage conversion in areas like Boise Heights, effective insulation is crucial due to seasonal temperature variations. Options typically include fiberglass batts, rigid foam boards, or spray foam insulation for walls, ceilings, and floors. The best choice depends on factors such as available space, desired R-value (thermal resistance), and budget. Maine Results, Inc. can recommend the most appropriate insulation solutions to ensure your new space is energy-efficient and comfortable year-round.
acceptedAnswer.description: Fiberglass, rigid foam, or spray foam insulation are common for garage conversions in Boise Heights; the best option depends on R-value needs and budget.
